priorityList: Apply poisons and Slice and Dice before combat, then enter Stealth.
Use Kick to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Apply and maintain Garrote; refresh it when it has less than 14 seconds remaining or when you have the Improved Garrote buff.
Apply and maintain Rupture at 5 or more Combo Points; avoid refreshing if Darkest Night is active and Rupture is already ticking.
Cast Deathmark when Garrote and Rupture are both ticking and Kingsbane is nearly ready (within 2 seconds).
Cast Kingsbane while Envenom is active and both Garrote and Rupture are ticking.
Use Vanish to refresh Garrote with the Improved Garrote buff, particularly while Deathmark is active.
Use offensive trinkets and racial cooldowns (like Blood Fury or Berserking) while Deathmark is active.
Use Shiv as a builder if Darkest Night is active and you have a 1 Combo Point deficit.
Use Envenom as your finisher at 5 or more Combo Points, or when Darkest Night is active and you are at maximum Combo Points.
Prioritize Envenom if you have fewer than 4 stacks of Implacable Tracker or are above 70% energy.
Use Ambush as your primary builder when Blindside is active or from Stealth.
Use Mutilate as your primary builder if Ambush is unavailable.
Use Thistle Tea if energy falls below 50% near the end of the encounter.
